mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_object ( bucket_name, object_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, uploaded_by_account_id, status ) VALUES ( #{file.bucketName}, #{file.objectKey}, #{file.originalName}, #{file.contentType}, #{file.sizeBytes}, #{file.sha256}, #{file.uploadedByAccountId}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.select: SELECT fo.file_object_id, pfp.property_unit_id, fo.bucket_name, fo.object_key, fo.original_name, fo.content_type, fo.size_bytes, fo.sha256, fo.status FROM property_floor_plan pfp JOIN file_object fo ON fo.file_object_id = pfp.file_object_id WHERE pfp.property_unit_id = #{propertyUnitId} AND fo.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT fo.file_object_id, CAST(NULL AS UNSIGNED) AS property_unit_id, fo.bucket_name, fo.object_key, fo.original_name, fo.content_type, fo.size_bytes, fo.sha256, fo.status FROM file_object fo WHERE fo.bucket_name = #{bucketName} AND fo.sha256 = #{sha256} AND fo.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY fo.file_object_id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_floor_plan (property_unit_id, file_object_id) VALUES (#{propertyUnitId}, #{fileObjectId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_object_id = VALUES(file_object_id), uploaded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE file_object SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE file_object_id = #{fileObjectId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
